title: Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) Privilege Escalation Vulnerability (CVE-2022-26923)
content: Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) allows an authenticated user to escalate privileges to Domain Administrator via certificate request anomalies (ESC1/ESC8). Standard Chartered Bank AD domains should disable vulnerable templates.

title: Okta Auth Bypass Vulnerability (CVE-2024-10924)
content: Okta AD Agent contains an authentication bypass vulnerability via input validation errors. Attackers can bypass MFA and sign-on policies.
